explication: Mongoose is an embedded networking library and web server for devices and desktop systems. Its central workflow is an application running the event manager, accepting network traffic, and handling it through a selected protocol; optional TLS secures connections. The library also offers a built-in TCP/IP stack and hardware drivers, firmware OTA support, and device-dashboard assets. The README documents these capabilities, but many implementations are not excerpted, so uncertain internal calls are omitted rather than inferred.
